reproduction_target: Downstream bioinformatic analyses of four sequencing assays comparing LSD1 WT vs S166A (and siSET) cells: (1) RNA-seq DEG (FastQC/MultiQC QC -> Rsubread hg38 align + featureCounts -> edgeR CPM/RPKM norm -> ROTS differential expression), (2) ATAC-seq (Bowtie2 GRCh38 align -> samtools/Picard -> MACS2 peaks -> Homer/bedtools annotation -> DESeq2 differential accessibility -> TOBIAS footprinting), (3) RRBS (TrimGalore/Cutadapt -> Bismark/Bowtie2 -> methylKit differential methylation), (4) ChIP-seq (nf-core/chipseq 2.1.0 hg38 + MACS2 -> tidybulk differential abundance -> deepTools), plus enrichment (Enrichr/GREAT/ChEA3/iPathwayGuide). CRITICAL: the paper has NO data-availability statement and NO sequencing-data accession (no GEO/SRA/ENA/ArrayExpress/PRIDE), and no analysis-code/script repository for the pipelines. Extensive wet-lab molecular biology, MS proteomics, and mouse xenograft work is upstream (W layer, OOS for computational reproduction).
granularity_note: Coarse one-step-per-named-tool from the RNA sequencing / ATAC-seq / RRBS / ChIP-seq data-analysis / Bioinformatics Analysis prose in Material and Methods. No sequencing data accession exists anywhere in the paper, so the data axis is 0 for every C-layer step and no step can reach RI even in principle -> all C-layer verdicts are NI. No pipeline code/script repository or code-availability statement exists (the single GitHub repo cited, CellMigrationLab/Plot-Stats, is for microscopy randomization-test/effect-size plotting, NOT the sequencing pipelines). Wet-lab / MS / in-vivo procedures counted in W, not verdicted. Stage-1 prose-only: no code executed, no workflow source read.

steps.label: RNA-seq QC: FastQC (v0.11.8) + MultiQC (v1.10) on raw paired-end reads (2x50bp, NovaSeq 6000)
RNA-seq alignment/quantification: Rsubread (v2.0.0) align to hg38 (paired-end, RefSeq annotation) + featureCounts (reverse-stranded), in Bioconductor (v3.9) / R (v3.6.1)
RNA-seq normalization: edgeR (v3.28.0) CPM + RPKM; hierarchical clustering with amap (v0.8-18, Pearson); PCA (R pca, unit-variance scaling)
RNA-seq differential expression: ROTS (v1.14.0), 166A vs control, FDR<0.05 and fold-change >=2 (824 DEGs reported)
ATAC-seq alignment: FastQC (0.11.9) QC; Bowtie2 (2.4.5) align to GRCh38 (2x50bp)
ATAC-seq BAM processing: samtools (1.8) bam conversion; Picard (2.27.1) SortSam/BuildBamIndex/MarkDuplicates
ATAC-seq peak calling: MACS2 (v2.2.9.1), params --gsize hs --qvalue 0.05 --format bam --nomodel --bdg --call-summits
ATAC-seq peak annotation/counting: Homer (4.10) annotatePeaks.pl (hg38); bedtools (2.29.1) slop (-l 250 -r 249) + coverage; median-of-ratio + RPM normalization
ATAC-seq differential accessibility + viz: DESeq2 (v1.40.2), R (4.3.1); pheatmap (1.0.12), EnhancedVolcano (1.18.0)
ATAC-seq footprinting: TOBIAS (v0.15.1) ATACorrect / ScoreBigwig / BINDetect
RRBS trimming: FastQC (0.11.9) QC; TrimGalore! (0.6.7) on Cutadapt (4.2), params --quality 22 --phred33 --gzip --rrbs --fastqc --paired
RRBS alignment/methylation extraction: Bismark (0.22.3) with Bowtie2 (2.5.2), GRCh38 + Gencode v41; bismark_methylation_extractor + filter_non_conversion (params documented)
RRBS differential methylation: methylKit (v1.26.0), R (4.3.1), CpG + 500bp tiled windows, meth.diff 25% / q<0.01; biomaRt (2.56.1) annotation; pheatmap (1.0.12) / EnhancedVolcano (1.18.0) viz
ChIP-seq pipeline: nf-core/chipseq (2.1.0) align to hg38, narrow peak calling, MACS2 p-value 0.001
ChIP-seq differential enrichment: tidybulk test_differential_abundance on consensus peak set (p<0.05, |log2FC|>0.5); GREAT regions-to-genes; Enrichr GO
ChIP-seq visualization: deepTools (v3.4.3) density plots + heatmaps
Functional/enrichment analysis: iPathwayGuide (AdvaitaBio), ChEA3 TF enrichment, Gene Set Correlation Enrichment (Chang et al. 2024), GSEA-based scoring — all web/black-box, no versions

headline.inference_inclusive_upper_bound: NI ceiling on ALL 17 computational steps. Although most tools carry exact version pins (FastQC v0.11.8, Rsubread v2.0.0, MACS2 v2.2.9.1, Bismark 0.22.3, nf-core/chipseq 2.1.0, TOBIAS v0.15.1, etc.), the paper provides NO sequencing-data accession (no GEO/SRA/ENA/ArrayExpress/PRIDE deposit and no data-availability statement) and NO pipeline analysis code/scripts. Missing input data caps the data axis at 0 for every step, so NO step can reach RI even in principle from the paper as written — the inference-inclusive upper bound is NI, not RI. Stage2 could only lift these if the raw sequencing data and analysis scripts are located outside the paper (e.g. via author request or a not-yet-linked repository); nothing in-paper enables it.
headline.coverage: 17 computational steps across RNA-seq, ATAC-seq, RRBS, ChIP-seq, and enrichment assessed from Methods prose; ~24 wet-lab / MS-proteomics / in-vivo steps counted (W) but out of computational-reproduction scope. No pipeline code repository exists; the only cited GitHub repo (CellMigrationLab/Plot-Stats) covers microscopy stats, not sequencing.

gaps.where: Entire sequencing analysis (RNA-seq, ATAC-seq, RRBS, ChIP-seq). No DATA AVAILABILITY statement anywhere; no GEO/SRA/ENA/ArrayExpress accession; no PRIDE/ProteomeXchange accession for the histone-PTM / AP-MS / targeted / xenograft proteomics.
gaps.missing: Raw and processed sequencing data are not deposited or locatable. Without input FASTQ/count matrices no computational step can be run, so the entire reproduction target is blocked at the data axis.
gaps.how_to_close: Deposit raw + processed sequencing data to GEO/SRA (RNA-seq, ATAC-seq, RRBS, ChIP-seq) and MS data to PRIDE/ProteomeXchange, and add a data-availability statement with accession numbers.

gaps.where: All pipeline steps C1-C17. No code-availability statement; no GitHub/GitLab/Zenodo/Software Heritage repository for the RNA-seq/ATAC-seq/RRBS/ChIP-seq analysis. The single cited repo (github.com/CellMigrationLab/Plot-Stats) is for microscopy randomization tests / Cohen's D plotting only.
gaps.missing: No analysis scripts, notebooks, nf-core config, or run order shared. edgeR/ROTS/DESeq2/methylKit/tidybulk custom-R analyses (C3,C4,C9,C13,C15) must be fully re-implemented from prose.
gaps.how_to_close: Publish the pipeline scripts + nf-core config + R/Rmd analysis with a run order to a public repo (GitHub + Zenodo DOI).

gaps.where: Software environments across four assays (R 3.6.1/Bioconductor 3.9 for RNA-seq; R 4.3.1 for ATAC/RRBS; nf-core/chipseq 2.1.0 for ChIP-seq; plus ~20 named CLI/R tools).
gaps.missing: No lockfile (renv.lock/conda-lock), no environment.yml, no container digest. Versions appear inline for most tools but transitive dependencies, OS, and system-lib closure are unspecified; several tools/methods carry no version (tidybulk, iPathwayGuide, ChEA3, Enrichr, GREAT, Gene Set Correlation Enrichment, R pca).
gaps.how_to_close: Ship renv.lock / conda-lock and/or a container digest per assay and declared platform; pin all tool versions including tidybulk and enrichment tools.

gaps.where: Stochastic steps: PCA/UMAP-style embeddings, DESeq2/edgeR/ROTS resampling, TOBIAS, MACS2 model.
gaps.missing: No random seeds reported for any step; determinism of DEG/DAR/DMR figures not guaranteed on re-run.
gaps.how_to_close: Report set.seed() values and pipeline -seed parameters.

gaps.where: Reference genomes/annotations: hg38 (RNA-seq RefSeq via Rsubread; ChIP-seq), GRCh38 (ATAC Bowtie2; RRBS Bismark) with Gencode v41.
gaps.missing: hg38 vs GRCh38 patch/build and exact RefSeq annotation release are not pinned to a specific version/URL for RNA-seq and ATAC/ChIP; only RRBS pins Gencode v41.
gaps.how_to_close: Pin exact genome build/patch and annotation release (URL + checksum) for each assay.
